newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sizhuang applies to issue 40 million A shares.
newsitem.headline: Sizhuang applies to issue 40 million A shares.

text.p: Guangxi Sizhuang Co Ltd plans to apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an initial public offering of 40 million A shares in 1997, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The company, which operates a paging network covering some 100,000 customers in Nanjing, capital of the southwestern Guangxi region, had not decided whether to list the domestic A shares in Shanghai or southern Shenzhen, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.
Hainan Hong Kong & Macao International Trust and Investment Co would underwrite Sizhuang's A shares, the official said.
If approved, Sizhuang planned to use some of the proceeds to acquire part of a stake in the local Guangxi airline that has three Boeing 737s flying on domestic routes, he said.
Guangxi Aviation's net assets were valued at 200 million yuan, the official said. He did not give details.
The remaining funds would be used to expand the firm's paging facilities, he said.
The official said Sizhuang expected per-share net profit of 0.30 yuan this year on current total share capital of 69 million shares, compared with about 0.20 yuan in 1995.
He did not give a breakdown of the company's share capital.
